classification: Scoped policy reviews and owner resolutions, not universal passing review

reviews.scope: Independent fresh-context review of supplied source policy and normal-use scenarios; no runtime dispatch or source execution
Independent fresh-context review of supplied source policy and normal-use scenarios; no runtime dispatch or source execution

owner_resolution.reason: Native delegation uses current task authority; separately billed/cross-provider calls remain within granted cost/source scope.
Retained untracked task artifacts persist; accessible dated receipts can be reused for unchanged model/harness/tools/task-class. No global registry required; first real shard can qualify.
Owner repeats enumeration before using negative/completeness claims; deterministic enumeration can feed workers directly.
New Critical authoring uses pinned records. Legacy format remains compatible. Declared identities are not authenticated and missing actual model identity is not invented.
Owner-selected, user-required and registered routes have distinct rules. A registered experiment without fallback cannot substitute.
Parallel ownership and integration clarified; whole-inventory captures need stable integrated source.
Switch route/direct owner when verification/repair exceeds direct effort.
Registration governs route choice only; does not override authority or proof requirements.
Response metadata instead of new artifacts when artifact creation is unauthorized.
Finalize arbitrary artifacts before capture or use authorized intentionally ignored evidence; report supported references/digests, no new unsupported fields.

Owner checks all contributors against review scope; separate actor/fresh context, no prior endorsement. Existing mechanical gate excludes only single named implementer; no plural runtime enforcement claimed.
Instructions alone are not confinement. Consequential routes need actual envelope checks or credential-free source packets/snapshots.
Family examples are candidates in a conditional reference, not fixed exact-version routes or proof of current price/capability. Dated specifics remain in research.
Check when selecting per-task route and reuse dated information absent relevant change/failure.
Authorized worker capture usable after owner checks logs/binding; read-only role without artifact authority does not capture.

limits: Reviewer proposals were assessed against actual existing source; not all suggestions were adopted

No evidence of general lower cost or higher complex-task accuracy
Native worker usage/model identity unavailable beyond configured routes; provider receipts do not authenticate weights
